home.title: Write; let who, where and when link themselves.
home.lead: Kenet is a personal journal that links the short entries you write during the day to people, places and time. Tasks and goals live in the same place. Your data stays yours as plain Markdown files.
home.storeBadgeSoon: Coming soon to the App Store
home.promise1Body: Markdown is the source of truth. The vault is local; there is no account. Delete the app and the files remain.
home.promise2Body: It writes to the file first, then updates its index. It never touches text it does not recognise. Deleting asks or can be undone.
home.promise3Body: The vault is the same as Obsidian's. No app-specific syntax, and the vault is not encrypted.
home.step2: The app recognises people, places and time.
home.step5: It writes to the daily file first, then updates the index.
home.platformsNote: The Mac app will reach the store later.
home.closingBody: The vault matches Obsidian's format; Kenet opens your existing vault in place.
